meta.source: Polar Window v2 (Concept A, Mission Console) — localhost:4180/index.html stylesheet

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and app bar ground (app bar at 88% over content with blur).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels, pick-list items, segmented-control track, selected ranking row, hover rows.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Raised fill inside a panel: the pressed segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, stats and sections; resting panel border.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Control borders (select, segmented, play button), table header rule, hover border, Blackout hatching stroke.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on bg, panel and panel-2 (16:1+ in both themes). Fill of the primary button and the scrubber playhead.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, eyebrows, axis labels, table headers on bg and panel (7.3:1 dark, 5.6:1 light).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary marks only: disabled text, minor ticks. Fails 4.5:1 for body text in both themes (3.8:1 dark, 2.8:1 light) — kept exact from v2; never use for readable copy.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: SUN. Sun lane, Sun disc tracks, Power only state, Sun % numbers, selected pick-item outline. Light theme: 3.3:1 on bg — fine for fills and marks, text only at 24px+; pair with a label.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: EARTH. Earth lane, Contact only state, Earth % numbers, slider accent. 4.8:1+ on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: both
tokens.usage: BOTH UP. Power and contact state in lanes, month bars and ranking bars. Light: 3.7:1 on bg — text only at 19px bold+. Differs from sun by hue only: always pair with the state label or icon.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: NEITHER. Blackout state and empty lane track; always overlay hatching in line-2 so it reads without colour.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Verdict GOOD band (strong ranking values, rule holds). Separate meaning from the both state, same hue in v2.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Verdict WARNING band (acceptable). Light: 3.6:1 — use at 18px+ bold or with an icon.

tokens.name: poor
tokens.usage: Verdict BAD band: weak ranking values, violated rules, red timeline marker at the first failing hour. 4.5:1+ on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus-visible outline, offset 2px, on every control and chart (11:1 dark, 4.8:1 light).

tokens.name: sky-bg
tokens.usage: Lunar sky panorama and sky plates. Black in EVERY theme — never a blue daytime sky.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Sky headline and time on sky-bg (18.8:1).

tokens.name: sky-sub
tokens.usage: Sky sub-line and date line on sky-bg.

tokens.name: sky-note
tokens.usage: Honesty labels on the sky (“elevation ×5”). Mono 11.5px; decorative-strength, keep the label also in Show as table.

tokens.name: sky-pill
tokens.usage: State badge fill over the sky.

tokens.name: sky-sun
tokens.usage: Sun disc core and state dot on the sky, fixed across themes.

tokens.name: sky-sun-core
tokens.usage: Sun disc hot centre (radial glow start).

tokens.name: sky-earth
tokens.usage: Earth disc lit side and Contact only badge on the sky.

tokens.name: sky-both
tokens.usage: Power and contact badge text and dot on the sky (12:1).

tokens.name: sky-none
tokens.usage: Blackout badge text on the sky.

tokens.name: terrain
tokens.usage: Terrain silhouette fill on the sky and in the brand mark.

tokens.name: ridge
tokens.usage: Sunlit ridge line stroke on the terrain silhouette.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: SAPLE terminal and code panel ground, both themes.

tokens.name: term-bg-2
tokens.usage: Terminal output section below the code.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Terminal body text (mono 12.5/1.6).

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar text.

tokens.name: term-key
tokens.usage: SPL keywords.

tokens.name: term-comment
tokens.usage: SPL comments. Decorative strength (3.7:1); comments only.

tokens.name: term-tick
tokens.usage: tick(n) durations and numbers in SPL.

tokens.name: term-ok
tokens.usage: ✓ holds lines in verification output.

tokens.name: term-err
tokens.usage: ✗ violated lines in verification output.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: sky-headline
styles.usage: State headline on the sky; width 122%; clamps 26–44px; sky-ink on sky-bg.

styles.name: big-numeral
styles.usage: Readout values; width 110%; tabular numerals; unit in a <small> at 0.42em, muted.

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: Wordmark next to the mark; width 125%; uppercase.

styles.name: rank-value
styles.usage: Ranking numbers; width 106%; coloured by band (good / fg / poor).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Labels above values and controls, sentence case, muted. (Was uppercase 11.5px in v2; changed for readability.)

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Arrays generate and the direct-to-Earth link is open.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: h3, point names in lists and rule names.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Pick a candidate landing point on the south pole map.
styles.usage: Section intro and sky sub-line; muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Plain-language captions under readouts and rule explanations; muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Definition-list values, coordinates, times (UTC); tabular numerals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: SPL model and saple CLI output in the terminal.

styles.name: axis
styles.usage: Chart ticks and notes (use Archivo in charts).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Title stacks, tight row gaps.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; scrubber gap.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Section internal gap; stats padding-top.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Gap between readout columns (each side of the hairline).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; gap between two-up panels.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Mission check column gap; stats padding-bottom.

tokens.name: space-44
tokens.usage: Section padding-top.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Filled segments inside lanes; key swatches.

tokens.name: radius-lane
tokens.usage: Lane tracks in the scrubber.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Focus outline corner.

tokens.name: radius-seg
tokens.usage: Pressed segment inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented-control track, selected ranking row. Select and brand mark use 9px.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Pick-list items, Teach explanation panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels and the terminal.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: State badges, quality badges, play button (circle).

tokens.name: wrap-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Select height; segmented track ~38px.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: play-size
tokens.usage: Play/pause button diameter.

tokens.name: sky-h-min
tokens.usage: Sky panorama min height (clamps to 540px at 40vw).

tokens.name: sky-h-max
tokens.usage: Sky panorama max height.

duration.note: Motion timing. Everything also works with motion off (prefers-reduced-motion stops all animation).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour and border changes, button press.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Tooltips, crop-mark growth, progress width.

tokens.name: dur-flip
tokens.usage: State headline flip, rule verdict flip.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Horizon-rule draw-on, count-up numerals, descent transitions.

tokens.name: dur-breath
tokens.usage: State-badge dot pulse (one breath).

tokens.name: dur-scan
tokens.usage: Skeleton scanning beam while computing.

tokens.name: dur-twinkle
tokens.usage: Starfield twinkle period (staggered per star).

tokens.name: dur-month
tokens.usage: Playing one 29.5-day lunar month in the scrubber.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for state changes.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: headline flip, tooltips, draw-on.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Verdict icons and the playhead knob: a small overshoot.
